changed.new_text: Each signed-in user has a budget of 120 requests per clock minute (fixed windows that start at second 0); from the 121st request of that minute on, the app answers 429 with code `rate_limited`, writes nothing, and sends a `Retry-After` header with the seconds left in the window.
changed.old_text: A signed-in user may make 120 requests per clock minute (fixed windows starting at second 0); the 121st and later requests in that minute answer 429 with code `rate_limited` and a `Retry-After` header giving the seconds until the window ends, and write nothing.

changed.new_text: `GET /v1/habits/{id}` returns the habit; for a soft-deleted habit it answers 404 `not_found`.
changed.old_text: `GET /v1/habits/{id}` answers the habit; a deleted habit answers 404 `not_found`.
